import Toybox.Graphics;import Toybox.WatchUi;import Toybox.Weather;class GfcIcons {static function draw_timely_008(dc as Graphics.Dc,x,y) as Void {var condition=null;try {var data=Weather.getCurrentConditions();if(data!=null){condition=data.condition;}}catch(e){}var resource=Rez.Drawables.GfcIcon_timely_008_missing;if(condition!=null){if(condition==0||condition==23||condition==40){resource=Rez.Drawables.GfcIcon_timely_008_clear;}else if(condition==1||condition==22||condition==52){resource=Rez.Drawables.GfcIcon_timely_008_partly;}else if(condition==2||condition==20){resource=Rez.Drawables.GfcIcon_timely_008_cloudy;}else if(condition==3||condition==11||condition==13||condition==14||condition==15||condition==24||condition==25||condition==26||condition==27||condition==31||condition==45||condition==49){resource=Rez.Drawables.GfcIcon_timely_008_rain;}else if(condition==4||condition==7||condition==10||condition==16||condition==17||condition==18||condition==19||condition==21||condition==34||condition==43||condition==44||condition==46||condition==47||condition==48||condition==50||condition==51){resource=Rez.Drawables.GfcIcon_timely_008_snow;}else if(condition==5||condition==32||condition==36||condition==37||condition==41||condition==42){resource=Rez.Drawables.GfcIcon_timely_008_wind;}else if(condition==6||condition==12||condition==28){resource=Rez.Drawables.GfcIcon_timely_008_thunder;}else if(condition==8||condition==9||condition==29||condition==30||condition==33||condition==35||condition==38||condition==39){resource=Rez.Drawables.GfcIcon_timely_008_fog;}}dc.drawBitmap(x,y,WatchUi.loadResource(resource));}}
